title: I was hoping for better!
text: I was hoping for better!. This peeler is okay. It does peel the apples but takes off too much peel. It is adjustable but only to a certain degree so for me if took too much of the apple. . There are no instructions really.. only a diagram which wasn't very helpful. It did suction to the counter.

product_metadata.title: Apple Peeler, Slicer, and Corer By SC Lifestyle: Apple Orchard Quality
features: Classic design makes coring, slicing, and peeling apples and potatoes a snap!
Made of enamel-coated cast-iron, stainless-steel blades, and a chrome shaft
Ideal for big jobs, but small enough to keep on your countertop for everyday peeling
description: This is the apple peeler that you remember from your trips to the orchard! Whether you have a big job or a single apple, this apple peeler/corer/slicer is perfect for the job. With the suction base and durable cast-iron body, it is tough enough to do the big jobs and still last many years. Multiple settings available enabling you to adjust the amount that is peeled off the apple and even allowing you to just peel the apple without coring. This is a must-have for every kitchen!
